description: This file defines the WorkspaceManager class for managing workspaces in Drupal, including methods for switching, retrieving, and managing workspaces and negotiators.

classes.name: WorkspaceManager
classes.description: Provides methods to manage workspaces, including switching, retrieving, and executing code within specific workspaces.

methods.name: hasActiveWorkspace
methods.description: Checks if there is an active workspace.

methods.name: getActiveWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves the current active workspace, determining it if not already set.

methods.name: setActiveWorkspace
methods.description: Sets a specified workspace as active, optionally persisting the change.

methods.name: switchToLive
methods.description: Switches the workspace to the live environment.

methods.name: doSwitchWorkspace
methods.description: Internal method to switch to a specified workspace, with access check and event dispatch.

methods.name: executeInWorkspace
methods.description: Executes a callback within a specified workspace context.

methods.name: executeOutsideWorkspace
methods.description: Executes a callback outside of any workspace context.

methods.name: purgeDeletedWorkspacesBatch
methods.description: Deprecated method to purge deleted workspaces, triggers a cron event.

methods.name: addNegotiator
methods.description: Adds a workspace negotiator service to the manager.
